textBox.richText: Jon and Sarah - Mount Vernon Country Club, Golden Colorado

Pastor Paul was the perfect choice for our wedding which was held in May 2010. We were looking for someone who could help us create a ceremony that was somewhat traditional, but also reflected ourselves and our personalities and Paul was that person. He was so easy to talk to and bounce ideas off of, and we were able to come up with our perfect ceremony with his help. We also really appreciated his willingness to travel to our wedding location, which was about 60 miles outside of town. The day of the wedding was everything we dreamed of and more! We could not have done it without the help of Pastor Paul. We would definitely recommend Pastor Paul to any couples who are looking for a great officiate for their dream wedding.
